text: Seabrook Town capitalized on a pressing trigger following Harbour City's clearance to launch a rapid counter-attack starting from their own half (x=59) involving three progressive passes over 13.2 seconds. Elias Haddad’s long progressive pass to Callum Varga initiated the wide overload characteristic of Seabrook’s 3-4-3 formation, culminating in a short assist by Tomas Kowalski to Kian Romano, who finished from 3.2 meters with an xG of 0.952 [#1901] [#1902] [#1903] [#1904] [#1906]. The high field tilt (69.6%) and Seabrook’s lower PPDA (4.6 vs Harbour’s 6.3) reflected effective territorial dominance and selective pressing enabling them to generate multiple big chances late in the game. Harbour City’s patient short passing was vulnerable to Seabrook’s quick transitions exploiting wide channels, decisively shifting the score from 3-2 to 4-2 at 90+3’.
